paper_baseline_execution_attempts.command: Rebuild dae.runtime with qwen3-8b-compute-ops.vdcore.build and -include cfloat, run Qwen3-8B --correctness, run -N 1 -b 5, then attempt the paper -N 64 -b 5 command.

paper_baseline_execution_attempts.title: VDCores Qwen3-8B Global Instruction Capacity Diagnostic
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.command: Apply local patch docs/nvidia-backend/baseline-patches/vdcores-qwen3-8b-global-insts-16384.patch to switch VDCores instruction fetch to global memory with numInsts=16384, rebuild dae.runtime with the Qwen3-8B compute-op set, run -N 64 -b 1, run -N 64 -b 5, run --correctness, then restore and rebuild the shared-instruction runtime.
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.observation: The capacity measurement showed the 64-token schedule needs up to 2177 compute instructions and 15042 memory instructions per SM. The global-instruction local patch rebuilt successfully, reduced static shared memory to 2336 bytes, and allowed the -N 64 -b 5 benchmark to run with median 303995744 ns. The same patched runtime failed several correctness thresholds, so this is diagnostic timing evidence only.
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.blocker: The global-memory instruction variant fixes the 64-token instruction-capacity overflow and produces timing, but it fails correctness thresholds; the VDCores paper row still needs either a correct global-instruction runtime path or a segmented/token-windowed schedule that preserves the shared-instruction runtime.

paper_baseline_execution_attempts.title: VDCores Qwen3-8B Shared-Instruction Window Plan
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.observation: The existing H200 instruction-capacity capture shows the shared runtime compiles 512 instructions per SM, while Qwen3-8B decode64 needs up to 2177 compute instructions and 15042 memory instructions per SM across all 132 SMs. The regenerated artifact now includes a bounded segmented-window manifest: 5 compute windows and 30 memory windows per SM, with every emitted window at or below the 512-instruction shared-table limit.
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.blocker: This is analysis evidence, not a runnable baseline. The VDCores paper row still needs builder/runtime support for a segmented or token-windowed shared-instruction schedule that reloads or advances instruction windows while preserving resident tensors, KV-cache state, dependencies, correctness, and per-window timing.

paper_baseline_execution_attempts.command: Run fwd/bwd, causal/non-causal PyTorch reference cells for sequence lengths 6144 and 12288 as separate H200 Python processes using tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/thunderkittens/pt-reference-isolated-60d797cd/run_pt_reference_cell.py.
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.observation: Fresh-process PyTorch reference runs recover the 6144-token official cells but still OOM at 12288 tokens.
paper_baseline_execution_attempts.blocker: The isolated capture recovers all 6144-token PyTorch reference cells, but all 12288-token PyTorch reference cells still OOM. The remaining official ThunderKittens reference gap is therefore true 12288-token dense PyTorch reference capacity, not only monolithic benchmark fragmentation.
